The '''''Trident''''' was the personal [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|''Trident''-class assault ship]] of the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Trident_landed.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Trident'' landed on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]]]
The ''Trident'' had at least two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The ship flew through space like an octopus or squid. It also could be used underwater, with its "tentacles" pushing itself through the water.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

It used its "tentacles" as landing gear and landed in an upright position. The ship has been described as "strangely configured".<ref name="TCWEG:THE" />

==History==
As the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] continued, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used the ''Trident'' to leave [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]<ref name="THE" /> for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she captured [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], who was in his [[Sail barge/Legends|father's sail barge]]. It blasted away one of the two [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] trying to protect the sail barge, then, with its [[Octopus/Legends|octopus]]-like tentacles, grabbed on to the barge and sailed away.<ref name="SW:TCWf" /> Ventress later used it during the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|Battle of Kadavo]].<ref name="Kadavo">[[The Clone Wars 6|''The Clone Wars'' 6]]</ref> It was also used at the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] for an underwater attack. The ship and several others of its class attacked [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]].<ref name="ARC">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>
